in_sanskrit.name: मधुर्ज्या
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who has sweetness within, or the one who is full of sweetness herself.

in_hindi.name: मधुर्ज्या
in_hindi.long_meaning: Madhur, which means sweet, is used as a suffix in Madhurjya to denote the presence of sweetness.

in_tamil.name: மதுர்ஜ்யா
in_tamil.long_meaning: Arumaiyal, which means one who is full of grace, is a Tamil equivalent of the Sanskrit Madhurjya. The suffix -jya denotes the presence of the quality described by the prefix.

in_telugu.name: మధుర్జ్యా
in_telugu.long_meaning: Madhura, which means sweet, is used as a suffix in Madhurjya to denote the presence of sweetness.

in_marathi.name: Madhurjya
